excerpt: Stay informed of all Diversity Collective and local LGBTQ community news and events here in Ventura County!
paragraphs: Stay informed of all Diversity Collective and local LGBTQ community news and events here in Ventura County!

Wondering what laws protect you and/or your transgender, gender diverse, or intersex friends and family in California and what resources you can turn to if you face discrimination?Multiple California LGBTQ+, Civil Rights, and Health Care Advocates have authored the attached Fact Sheet in response to recent executive orders. It is intended to help you better understand your rights, and advocate for yourself and others in your community.
Click the link to view the Anti-Trans Community Fact Sheet
Disclaimer: It is not meant as legal advice. If you or someone you know is currently facing any legal issues, you should consult an attorney.

title: transgender-day-of-remembrance-tdor
excerpt: Stay informed of all Diversity Collective and local LGBTQ community news and events here in Ventura County!
paragraphs: Stay informed of all Diversity Collective and local LGBTQ community news and events here in Ventura County!
Join us as we honor the transgender folks we’ve lost in the U.S. this year and celebrate the strength and resiliency of our community.

This year there are multiple ways to participate, including a live stream. The main live event is at Ventura College’s Guthrie Hall, and, for the first time, folks in the East County can also join us at the Chalice Lounge in Newbury Park for a live community viewing party. CLU will also have a room available for viewing as well (contact their GSA for more information). If transportation or health concerns make it difficult for you to attend in person, join us via the live stream on The Transverse YouTube channel.
The event features powerful speakers, free food and refreshments, community resources, and a candlelight vigil, all in warm, welcoming community spaces and completely free to the community.
Wednesday, November 20th    5pm – 8pm
Ventura College, 4667 Telegraph Rd, Ventura, CA 93003
Chalice Lounge in Newbury Park (viewing party)
Presented by The Transverse, Diversity Collective Ventura County, Coalition for Family Harmony, and VC Pride Pirates
To Donate, visit the TDOR donation page
For more information, visit Trans Pride Ventura County

As MPOX continues to affect people in the community throughout the US, is it important to stay vigilant. Being aware of the symptoms and knowing the appropriate actions to take can keep you and others healthy.
You can contact Diversity Collective and we can help provide more information and connect you with Ventura County Public Health.
More information can also be found online at Ventura County Public Health and California Department of Public Health websites.

excerpt: Stay informed of all Diversity Collective and local LGBTQ community news and events here in Ventura County!

Calling all students!! Join Diversity Collective and Rainbow Umbrella for our very first GSA Leadership Summit
at our Community Resource Center – 2471 Portola Rd, Suite 100, Ventura, CA 93003

This summit is for middle school, high school, and college students looking to start, build, or expand a GSA group in their school. You’ll learn skills on how to community build and participate in advocacy through leadership. We are looking for representatives from every school in Ventura County.
Each school will receive a FREE GSA starter kit that includes flags, local LGBTQ+ resources, notebooks, and more.

If you have any questions or need any additional support, please reach out to Rainbow Umbrella. You can DM us on Instagram (@ruyouthgroup) or email Thomas Valenzuela (they/them), our Youth Programs Coordinator.

Pride Prom is coming May 30th! Members of the LGBTQ+ community ages 13-23 are invited to attend. Register for tickets at our organizational partner: https://www.dtsocialclub.org/pride-prom Also stay tuned for related fundraising and volunteer opportunities — we need your help to make this the best Pride Prom ever!
We still have sponsorships available, and while any amount is welcome, donations $500 or more are eligible for special perks like logos on posters, Instagram posts, banners, and on-stage promotions.

The theme this year is Mystical Forest and the venue is the beautiful new Palomino in Downtown Ventura, featuring bites from longtime supporter Season’s Catering. We are excited to be one of the first events in this new venue!

title: surviving-the-holidays-tips-and-resources
excerpt: Stay informed of all Diversity Collective and local LGBTQ community news and events here in Ventura County!
paragraphs: Stay informed of all Diversity Collective and local LGBTQ community news and events here in Ventura County!

Holidays can be a difficult time for the LGBTQ+ community. Traditional activities and family relations can be complicated and strained, leaving us feeling raw, overwhelmed, and upset before, during, and after the holidays. It is important to identify ways to support ourselves and stay physically and mentally healthy to better deal with rough situations.

Self-care plans look different from person to person. Self-care is a way to love and support ourselves when we need it most. It can help us feel calmer, and it can give us a sense of control when things feel out of control.

title: pride-training-parents-and-family
excerpt: Stay informed of all Diversity Collective and local LGBTQ community news and events here in Ventura County!
paragraphs: Stay informed of all Diversity Collective and local LGBTQ community news and events here in Ventura County!
Join us for our LGBTQ+ Cultural Competency Training for Parents and Family on Saturday, March 2nd from 10:30AM-2:30PM at our Community Resource Center.

Our PRIDE training (Parents and Professionals’ Responsibility for Inclusion, Diversity, and Equity) was created to educate families with LGBTQ+ youth using evidence based on the R.I.S.E. Model of the LA LGBT Center. This training aims to decrease the high incidence of trauma and suicide in the LGBTQ+ community, with an emphasis on “permanency” in the lives of LGBTQ+ youth.
Please RSVP here: https://wkf.ms/3I0lZDR
